findings.finding: Actual current canonical source/primary resource link derivation is outside the generic verifier. It compares the supplied bounded context and actual public/canonical bytes. OwnerSource authenticates the historical source owner/ID, not the full present-day goal/placement schema.
findings.requiredHandling: Preserve exact independent source extraction, unique primary-link derivation, active-input pins and separate scope/authority gates during integration. A private capability alone cannot certify the entire current goal or offer.

findings.finding: Correction676684da supplies only DE title/description plus image in its native context. Current EN and demand edits still yield a valid DE-only capability; inventing those fields in the receipt fails.
findings.requiredHandling: Do not consume a DE-only successful capability as English, demand, D/P, general scope or human approval. This restriction is faithful to the bound corrected original.
